files.sidebar.css: .sidebar{--gutter:12px;--row-pad:12px;--icon:20px;--gap:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;width:260px;max-width:100%;padding:16px var(--gutter);background:#f7f8fa;color:#222c3c;box-sizing:border-box}.sidebar nav{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto}.sidebar h2{font-size:12px;margin:12px 0 8px;padding-inline:calc(var(--row-pad) + var(--icon) + var(--gap)) var(--row-pad)}.sidebar ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.nav-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--gap);width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px var(--row-pad);border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit}.nav-icon{flex:0 0 var(--icon);text-align:center}.nav-row[aria-current=page]{background:#e2eaff;font-weight:700;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 #365dc9}.nav-row:disabled{color:#626c7c;cursor:not-allowed}.nav-row small{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:400}.workspace-summary{padding:12px calc(var(--row-pad) + var(--icon) + var(--gap));border-radius:6px;background:#e9edf3;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.workspace-summary p{font-size:12px;margin:6px 0 0}.sidebar footer{display:flex;gap:8px;padding-inline:var(--row-pad)}.sidebar footer button{font:inherit;font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px;background:white;border:1px solid #b9c1ce;border-radius:5px}.sidebar button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #365dc9;outline-offset:-3px}
